question: Should OpenClaw adopt `write.append` and optional `SandboxFsBridge.appendFile` as supported public contracts for backends that can provide authoritative native append semantics?
rationale: The implementation is technically credible, but accepting a new model-facing tool parameter and Plugin SDK method establishes lasting compatibility and backend-support expectations that automation cannot choose.

options.title: Sponsor the gated API
options.body: Approve the additive contracts, require the current check failures to be repaired, and merge with unsupported bridges continuing to omit append.

options.title: Keep append internal
options.body: Retain native append only for core-owned memory or runtime paths and remove the model-facing and Plugin SDK surface from this PR.

options.title: Do not add append
options.body: Close the feature direction and leave the linked data-loss issue for a different protection or coordination design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated API
recommendation.body: Approve the additive contracts, require the current check failures to be repaired, and merge with unsupported bridges continuing to omit append.

likelyOwner.reason: The best available history signal is ownership of the pinned filesystem mutation and safety boundary that this public capability extends.
